text:
Maria: hey team — quick follow-ups from the all-hands about travel, offsites and hybrid norms. trying to summarize so we can action: 1) travel approvals for customer/partner meetings (who signs off for >$2k?) 2) offsite owner responsibilities (rooms, agenda, catering budget) 3) desk booking at satellite hubs — any changes? 4) per-diem / meals policy for multi-day trips — what’s reimbursable? @Jamal @Leo tagging you since you mentioned updates on stage.

Jamal: thanks Maria — good recap. approvals: TL;DR — for customer/partner meetings under $2k your manager approves; between $2k-$10k People Ops + Manager; >$10k requires Director sign-off. we’ll publish an approval matrix today. for partner travel where we contract travel, ops should be looped in early. :+1:

Olivia: quick Q on that — if someone combines a customer visit and a conference in the same trip, do we split approval or treat total trip cost? also any guidance on bringing a +1?

Jamal: treat total trip cost for approval thresholds. +1s are allowed only for extenuating circumstances and need Director pre-approval and cover incremental costs personally unless approved by People Ops. will add to the FAQ.

Leo: facilities note for offsites: we updated the offsite checklist and added a small-template for agendas and run-of-show. link here: https://intranet.redwood/ops/offsite-checklist (internal)  — short excerpt below for quick reference:

```
Offsite owner checklist (summary):
- Submit request 6 weeks prior via People Ops form
- Budget cap: $5k standard (exemptions require Director approval)
- Catering: opt for 2 meal slots + snacks (dietary prefs required)
- Rooms: reserve main + breakout via Room Booker 2 weeks prior
- Travel: attach attendee list and preferred travel windows
```

Leo: also — satellite hub desk booking is unchanged: 14-day rolling reservation window, 2 consecutive days max for hot desks, 30-day max for assigned desks. If you need extended access for project work, request via facilities@redwood and include justification.

peopleops-bot: Updated doc published: "Travel & Offsite Policy v2.1" — https://intranet.redwood/ops/travel-policy-v2.1 (auto) :page_facing_up:

Maria: awesome, thanks. one more ask — can we get a short slide or 1-pager for managers summarizing the new matrix so they can share with their teams? @peopleops-bot any ETA on the manager one-pager?

peopleops-bot: People Ops expects a manager one-pager by EOD Tuesday. Attaching the draft checklist to the doc.

Olivia: thanks! will loop this into our eng-team sync and flag anything unclear. :wave:

Jamal: thanks everyone — will follow up in Slack when the approval matrix live. if anything urgent (travel this week) DM me directly.

Maria: noted, closing the loop. TL;DR: approval matrix published soon, offsite checklist + booking rules updated, manager one-pager by Tuesday. :white_check_mark:
